headline: Jakmania Celebrate 98th Anniversary Of Persija At Bundaran HI
seoTitle: Jakarta Security Preparations For Public Protests
metaDescription: Thousands of Jakmania supporters gathered at Bundaran HI to mark Persija Jakarta's 98th anniversary, causing significant traffic congestion in the area.
aiSummaryBullets: Thousands of Jakmania supporters gathered at Bundaran HI to commemorate the 98th anniversary of Persija Jakarta.
The celebration involved the use of flares and fireworks, attracting large crowds to the central Jakarta landmark.
The influx of supporters caused significant traffic congestion, prompting authorities to implement traffic engineering measures.
aiContextParagraph: On November 27, 2026, thousands of Jakmania supporters converged on the Bundaran HI area in Central Jakarta to celebrate the 98th anniversary of the football club Persija Jakarta. The event was marked by a vibrant display of pyrotechnics, including flares and fireworks, which illuminated the area. This large-scale gathering resulted in substantial traffic disruption, specifically impacting the flow of vehicles from the Dukuh Atas area toward Sarinah. In response to the congestion, local authorities initiated traffic engineering measures to manage the flow of vehicles through the vicinity. While earlier reports from November 10, 2026, focused on widespread public demonstrations across various locations including Bundaran HI and the DPR building, the recent activity is explicitly attributed to the club's anniversary celebrations rather than political protests.
whyItIsViral: The event is trending due to coverage from four independent outlets reporting on the large-scale celebration and the resulting traffic impact in central Jakarta.
